Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

About the role 
 Ipsos Innovation Service Line aims to revamp its product testing process, transitioning from its current manual execution process to a more efficient digital platform encompassing the end-to-end process.
 Ipsos is looking to hire a full stack software engineer who will be responsible for leading the development and implementation of technologies, whether home-grown or vendor packaged, that will satisfy Ipsos’ business goals.
 This position requires technical acumen and collaboration skills. We are looking for individuals who are highly logical and creative in their approach to software development, who have experience making technical decisions, and who have the ability to "think outside the box”.
 While experience with the specific technologies we use (React front-end and .NET Core back-end).) is important, we are equally interested in general application architecture and design competency.
 You will need to adhere to and improve our decoupled, API-first architecture, ensuring clean separation between the UI and backend services.
 Our technologists are involved in all aspects of project lifecycle, working closely with the business community, and with members of other technical disciplines (Architecture, PM, BA, QA) from project inception to transition.
 We value well rounded individuals who bring a mix of hard technical skills, structured problem-solving methodology, peripheral vision, and interpersonal skills to the table.
 Responsibilities 
 You will play a key role within the team by actively contributing to the growth and evolution of our software:
Design, build, and maintain high-quality, scalable features across the entire stack (React front-end and .NET Core back-end)
Collaborate closely with architects to co-build solutions, define, and implement best practices
Improve overall quality (unit tests, code reviews, test coverage, performance, security) in partnership with QA and other developers
Write optimized queries for PostgreSQL and utilize GCP Pub/Sub for asynchronous event-driven communication with other enterprise building blocks.
Contribute to delivery processes: CI/CD using via Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) DevOps, configuration management, deployments, and monitoring
Document essential elements to streamline onboarding and maintenance
Implement excellent solutions that address business needs
Translate requirements into technical specifications
Review and improve legacy code
Analyze program performance and troubleshoot issues
Participate in testing and validation processes
Improve engineering best practices
Deliver solutions on time and within budget
Follow architectural standards
Communicate status and risks
Stay up to date with industry trends
 Experience 
5+ years of experience in software development
Strong proficiency in .NET Core (C#), building RESTful, API-first services
Solid experience with React and modern frontend state management/workflows
Experience working with PostgreSQL (relational database design, query optimization)
Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and containerized applications via Docker and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)
Experience with cloud-native structured logging
Strong communication and collaboration skills
Ability to take ownership and deliver
Ability to manage multiple priorities
Strong problem-solving mindset
Experience with design and modeling tools
Experience in hybrid technology environments
Strong computer science fundamentals
Takes pride in code quality, documentation, and the long-term health of the application.
Fluency in English
Project management skills
Experience working in Agile frameworks (Scrum)
